Why people switch

Three reasons people leave Typeform every day

Not a knock — Typeform makes great forms. But the pricing model creates real pain as you grow.

😤

10 free responses is nothing

Typeform's free plan caps you at 10 responses per month. A single social media post can use that up in an hour. FormflowX gives you 100 — enough to actually test and validate.

💸

Paying $59/mo just to remove their logo

Typeform locks white-labeling behind their Plus plan at $59/month. FormflowX removes all branding on Pro at $15/month — the same feature, for a quarter of the price.

🔀

Conditional logic is paywalled

On Typeform's free plan, every respondent sees every question. Logic branching is a paid feature. On FormflowX, conditional logic works on the free plan — because smart routing shouldn't cost extra.

FAQ

Common questions about switching

Is FormflowX a true Typeform alternative — same UX?

Yes. FormflowX uses the same one-question-at-a-time format that Typeform pioneered, with smooth transitions between questions, keyboard navigation, and a conversational feel. If you love how Typeform looks and flows, you'll feel at home — with more features and a lower bill.

Can I import my existing Typeform forms?

FormflowX supports importing your questions and logic from Typeform. Log in, go to "New form → Import", and paste your Typeform link. Questions, options, and branching logic migrate automatically.

Why does Typeform only give 10 free responses?

Typeform made a deliberate pricing decision to push users to paid plans quickly. 10 responses per month is genuinely not enough to test a form in production. FormflowX chose 100/month because we believe you should be able to validate your forms before committing to a subscription.

Does FormflowX have conditional logic on the free plan?

Yes, full conditional logic — branch by answer, skip questions, jump to sections — is available on the free plan. Typeform restricts logic branching to paid tiers.

Can I remove FormflowX branding for $15/month?

Yes. The Pro plan at $15/month removes all "Powered by FormflowX" branding and lets you use a custom domain. Typeform requires their $59/month Plus plan for the same combination of features.

Ready to switch from Typeform?

Free forever. 100 responses/month. No credit card. Takes 2 minutes to build your first form.
